mapper.select: SELECT p.id::text AS id, p.slug, p.title, cat.name AS category_name, cat.color AS category_color, p.publication_type, p.access_type, p.credit_price, p.status, p.delivery_status, p.published_at, p.updated_at, p.cover_file_id, p.featured FROM publications p JOIN categories cat ON cat.id = p.category_id AND cat.is_deleted = false WHERE p.is_deleted = false ORDER BY p.updated_at DESC, p.id DESC

SELECT p.id::text AS id, p.category_id::text AS category_id, p.slug, p.title, p.summary, p.publication_type, p.access_type, p.credit_price, p.status, p.delivery_status, p.published_at, body.preview_markdown, body.full_markdown, body.requirements, body.deliverables, body.version, p.created_at, p.updated_at, p.cover_file_id, p.featured FROM publications p JOIN categories cat ON cat.id = p.category_id AND cat.is_deleted = false JOIN publication_contents body ON body.publication_id = p.id AND body.is_deleted = false WHERE p.is_deleted = false AND p.id = #{id}
